$comment: Single versioned source of installer identity. Edited here, never at the destination. `pnpm brand:build` derives the artwork; `pnpm check:installer` proves tauri.conf.json and the .desktop entry still say what this file says. Every field here has a consumer: a key nobody reads would still be hashed as an artwork input and would force a pointless rebuild.

shortDescription.en: Turn Cities: Skylines saves into printable maps.
shortDescription.es: Convierte partidas de Cities: Skylines en mapas imprimibles.

longDescription.en: Vellum is an offline desktop application that reads a Cities: Skylines .cslmap export and draws it as a cartographic map you can style and export to PNG or SVG. It works entirely on your machine: no account, no telemetry, and the only network request it ever makes is the update check you can turn off.
